description: The CPVPD-2024 research team publishes photovoltaic-plant vectors for China. Its Zenodo deposit packages the data under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The descriptor identifies 34 provincial Shapefile layers, each with geometry, index, projection, attribute and character-encoding components. The mapping method uses remote-sensing imagery and topographic information, while the released product supplies plant locations and outlines for 2024. These vectors can improve spatial generation inventories and hazard overlays in power-system simulations, alongside data-global-power-plant-database as a separate asset source. A caveat is that an image-derived outline is not verified installed capacity, ownership or interconnection status. Provincial boundary handling, overlapping polygons and the accuracy of small facilities need file-level review. The own metadata and package listing were inspected without downloading vector layers or reproducing the classifier.
